Massive Boulder Throw. Massive Projectile: choose a point within 120 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered there must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone; on a successful save, it takes half damage and is not knocked prone.

The weapon carries the habits of its makers: iron darkened by smoke, edges nicked by old wars, and balance tuned for the cruel seconds when a line breaks. It is not an ornament but a battlefield answer, meant to decide distance, courage, and blood before mercy can speak.

“The Old World rewards only those who turn fear into steel.”
— a scarred captain of the Empire

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
